text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way home from an outing with Dantsu 
Flame—

text_block_list.name: Vodka Fan
text_block_list.text:
Vodka-san! I watched your last race! You 
were insanely cool! I'll keep cheering for 
you!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Oh, thanks! Heheh, I'm gonna show you my 
absolute coolest self in the next race, 
too!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Root for me, got it? I won't let you down! 
Look forward to it!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Wah... Vodka-chan is so confident and 
cool...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"You're right. There's no way she'd act in 
a way that would disappoint the fans 
cheering for her..."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Standing tall, with confidence... Making 
people feel at ease... Yeah, that really 
feels like the caliber of a true star.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: I-I need to follow their example too.

text_block_list.name: Grass's Fan
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder-san, your running is always 
such an inspiration to me. Thank you so 
much.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Oh... I am truly honored to hear you say 
that. Even though I still have much to 
learn...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I shall devote myself diligently. ...So 
that I do not betray your expectations.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...I-I see. Humility is important too, 
isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Never boastful, possessing an inner 
strength...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, this feels like what it really means 
to be the main character...

text_block_list.name: Brian Fan
text_block_list.text:
B-Brian-san!? Whoa, the real deal…… Um, 
have you decided on your next race yet!? 
I'll definitely come watch!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Do as you please.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: S-So cool...!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Saying little, standing firm and 
composed... It exudes the reassuring aura 
of the truly strong...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
She has that aura of a main character, 
doesn't she...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Everyone has their own unique charm, and 
it feels like every single one of them is 
the main character...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I knew that, but if that's the case... 
what kind of leading role... should I 
strive to be...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Dants Flame fell into deep thought, as if 
sorting through the words within herself.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"I want to win races and take center 
stage. So then, what kind of person should 
I be in my daily life...? That sort of 
thing."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Doing what's right as the lead? How should 
I put it...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She seems unable to put it into words 
properly, but perhaps she's searching for 
the 'correct' way to be a leading star.
choice_data_list: I don't think there's a right answer.
I think it's about who you want to become.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: There is no right answer...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There are many Umamusume at Tracen 
Academy. Every single one of them has the 
potential to become a star.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...Yes. I was well aware of that, though.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, I see.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"Maybe it's because inside me... there's 
nothing that makes me feel like a 'lead 
character' the way I see in everyone 
else..."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"So, wanting that... might be why I 
thought I wanted to know the right 
answer."
choice_data_list: I don't think you lack it at all.
I don't think it's something you lack.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you very much. Hehe. If you say 
so, Trainer, then maybe there really is.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"Still... I just haven't been able to find 
it yet."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"If I can just find that... perhaps then, 
I can become a true leading lady."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...What I want to become.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: I see. So there's no single right answer.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Then... would it be alright for me to 
believe that someone like me could also be 
a protagonist...?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. It really puts me at ease when 
you're so clear with me, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
From now on... I might find new ideals 
that are different from the ones I have 
now.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"Whatever shape it takes... I'll do my 
very, very best to become what I've always 
aimed to be!"
